name: ES Opening Inventory Recapture v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
hypothesis: The opening auction can establish accepted directional inventory. If lunch participants temporarily force price through the evolving cumulative session value center but fail to hold that state, their inventory is trapped when both cumulative value and price recapture the opening side by 13:29. The failed state transition should release in the original direction into the close.

state_anchors.opening_center: volume-weighted mean of one-minute typical price from 09:30 through 09:59
state_anchors.dynamic_session_center: cumulative volume-weighted mean of one-minute typical price from 09:30 through each observed minute

state_machine.initial_long_acceptance: opening center > cash open and 09:59 close > cash open
state_machine.initial_short_acceptance: opening center < cash open and 09:59 close < cash open
state_machine.long_dislocation_state: at least one lunch-window one-minute close is strictly below that minute's dynamic session center
state_machine.short_dislocation_state: at least one lunch-window one-minute close is strictly above that minute's dynamic session center
state_machine.long_recapture_state: at 13:29, final cumulative center > cash open and 13:29 close > final cumulative center
state_machine.short_recapture_state: at 13:29, final cumulative center < cash open and 13:29 close < final cumulative center
state_machine.long_signal: initial long acceptance, long dislocation state, and long recapture state all occur
state_machine.short_signal: initial short acceptance, short dislocation state, and short recapture state all occur

execution.entry: 13:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.stop_fill: final cumulative center plus one adverse ES tick
execution.entry_validity: skip if the frozen stop fill is not adverse to the simulated entry
execution.same_bar_rule: if the 13:30 entry bar touches the stop trigger, assume the stop fills
execution.gap_through_rule: if a stop bar opens beyond the trigger, fill at the worse bar open plus one adverse tick; otherwise fill at the frozen stop price
execution.survivor_exit: 15:55 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

lesson: Opening acceptance followed by lunch dislocation and recapture contained some directional information, but the complete state sequence occurred only about once per week and its profit was concentrated in 2022. A more elaborate state machine reduced frequency without improving temporal stability. The dislocation state must not be removed, loosened, or copied to additional clock windows after observing this result.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed frequency and cross-year development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: requiring more or fewer dislocation bars
weekday, volatility, volume, or regime filters
changing the stop or exit after observing results
